articles.title: Michelin Keys 2026 Recognises Three of Sands China's Esteemed Properties as Among the Best Globally
articles.rawDate: Sep.24 Michelin Keys 2026 Recognises Three of Sands China's Esteemed Properties as Among the Best Globally
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 24, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. has once again demonstrated its world-class hospitality expertise with three of its celebrated properties securing prestigious Michelin Keys in the 2026 selection. For the second consecutive year, The Londoner Hotel, Four Seasons Hotel Macao, and The St. Regis Macao have all been awarded One Key.

articles.title: Celebrating Two Michelin Keys for Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong
articles.summary: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has been elevated from One Michelin Key to Two Michelin Keys in the Michelin Guide’s 2026 hotel selection, marking a significant milestone just one year after the Michelin Key distinction was first introduced in Hong Kong.

articles.title: Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.rawDate: Sep.19 Sands China Leads Macao Awardees with Most Restaurants Recognised on Trip.Gourmet's 2027 Fine Dining List
articles.summary: (Macao, September 19, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. has reinforced its status as a premier gastronomic destination with six of its signature restaurants earning ratings on Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Fine Dining List, giving it the honour of having the most awardees in Macao under one roof. The Huaiyang Garden received Black Diamond, La Chine received Diamond, and Gordon Ramsay Pub & Grill, Jiang Nan by Jereme Leung, Zi Yat Heen and The Manor received Platinum.

articles.title: SJM’s Three Flagship Hotels Garner Six MICHELIN Keys the Most in Macau
articles.summary: (Macau, 18 September 2026) Three flagship hotels of SJM Resorts — Grand Lisboa Palace Macau, THE KARL LAGERFELD MACAU, and Palazzo Versace Macau — have each retained the MICHELIN Two Key distinction for a second consecutive year in the 2026 MICHELIN Key selection. Together, the three properties have garnered a total of six MICHELIN Keys, the most in Macau.

articles.title: Grand Lisboa Palace Becomes Greater China’s First Sustained Carbon-Neutral Integrated MICE Venue
articles.summary: (Macau, 17 September 2026) — SJM Resorts announced that Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau has become the first integrated MICE venue in Greater China to achieve sustained carbon neutrality through high-quality carbon credits. The company also launched Macau’s first standardised Zero-Carbon MICE Service and hosted a Green MICE Forum with more than 150 industry leaders.

articles.title: SJM’s The SPA at Palazzo Versace Macau Wins SpaChina Wellness & Spa Award
articles.summary: (Macau, 17 September 2026) The SPA at Palazzo Versace Macau, at Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau, has been awarded Best Holistic / TCM Treatment of the Year at the SpaChina Wellness & Spa Awards 2026. The honour recognises its Signature Meridian Yin Yang Full Body Therapy, which combines traditional Chinese wellness with contemporary techniques.

articles.title: GEG Wins Four Accolades at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards; Including “Best Integrated Resort” for the Fourth Consecutive Year and “Best Individual CSR Initiative”
articles.summary: September 16, 2026 – Galaxy Entertainment Group garnered four awards at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards in Manila, making it once again the most awarded integrated resort operator in Macau. Galaxy Macau was named Best Integrated Resort for the fourth consecutive year and Best IR Gaming Floor, Capella at Galaxy Macau was named Best Hotel in an IR for the second consecutive year, and the GEG Sports for Good Community Program received Best Individual CSR Initiative.

articles.title: The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.rawDate: Sep.15 The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 15, 2026) – To mark a decade of French-inspired hospitality, The Parisian Macao hosted a three-night Moët & Chandon dinner over the past weekend for government officials, VIPs and media. Evenings at Le Cristal Parisian featured a five-course champagne-paired menu by Moët & Chandon executive chef Jean-Michel Bardet, with views of the Eiffel Tower and a 1,500-drone anniversary show.

articles.title: 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.rawDate: Sep.13 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 13, 2026) – To promote social inclusion, support community sports in Macao, and respond to the SAR government’s “sports + tourism” initiative, Sands China held the 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival at the University of Saint Joseph, attracting over 250 residents. Co-organized with Macau Special Olympics and the university, the carnival brought together special education schools, community centres, residential care homes, secondary-school teams, Sands Cares Ambassadors and the Sands China basketball team.
